units.source_text: “那是因为他喜欢千重子呗，连这点你都不明白？

en.t: "That is because he likes Chieko, of course. Do you not even understand that?

units.source_text: 他曾说你比中宫寺和广隆寺的弥勒佛爷还美哪……

en.t: He once said you were even more beautiful than the Maitreya statues at Chuguji and Koryuji...

units.source_text: 连爸爸都吓一跳，那么一个别扭的小伙子，竟会说出这样了不起的话来。”

en.t: Even Father was startled that such an awkward young man could say something so remarkable."
